import { ReactNode, RefObject } from "react";
import { PicodashJsonValue, ValueGesture, ValueGestureOptions } from "@picodash/nexus";
import "react-aria-components";
type ValueGestureFactory<Value extends PicodashJsonValue> = (options?: ValueGestureOptions) => Omit<ValueGesture, 'update'> & {
  update(value: Value): ReturnType<ValueGesture['update']>;
};
type NumericGestureFactory = ValueGestureFactory<number>;
type SliderDetent = {
  /** Numeric sentinel outside the interval. Values in the intervening gap are never emitted. */
  readonly value: number;
  readonly label: string;
};
type SliderOptions = {
  readonly startDetent?: SliderDetent;
  readonly endDetent?: SliderDetent;
  /** Interactive bounds within the unchanged min/max track scale. */
  readonly allowedRange?: {
    readonly min: number;
    readonly max: number;
  };
  /** Fill from this value, using accent above it and danger below it. */
  readonly fillOrigin?: number;
};
type ChoiceControlProps = {
  readonly id?: string;
  readonly 'aria-label'?: string;
  readonly 'aria-labelledby'?: string;
  readonly 'aria-describedby'?: string;
  readonly 'aria-invalid'?: boolean | 'true' | 'false';
  readonly 'aria-errormessage'?: string;
  readonly disabled?: boolean;
  readonly readOnly?: boolean;
  readonly className?: string;
};
type ChoiceValue = string | number;
type CheckboxProps = ChoiceControlProps & {
  readonly isSelected: boolean;
  readonly onChange: (isSelected: boolean) => void;
};
declare function Checkbox$1({ isSelected, onChange, ...props }: CheckboxProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type RadioGroupProps<T extends ChoiceValue> = ChoiceControlProps & {
  readonly value: T | undefined;
  readonly onChange: (value: T) => void;
  readonly options: readonly SelectOption<T>[];
  readonly orientation?: 'vertical' | 'horizontal';
};
declare function RadioGroup$1<T extends ChoiceValue>({ value, onChange, options, orientation, ...props }: RadioGroupProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element;
type ComboboxProps<T extends ChoiceValue> = ChoiceControlProps & {
  readonly value: T | undefined;
  readonly onChange: (value: T) => void;
  readonly options: readonly SelectOption<T>[];
  readonly placeholder?: string;
};
declare function Combobox<T extends ChoiceValue>({ value, onChange, options, placeholder, ...props }: ComboboxProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element;
type CheckboxGroupProps<T extends ChoiceValue> = ChoiceControlProps & {
  readonly value: readonly T[];
  readonly onChange: (value: readonly T[]) => void;
  readonly options: readonly SelectOption<T>[];
};
declare function CheckboxGroup$1<T extends ChoiceValue>({ value, onChange, options, ...props }: CheckboxGroupProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element;
type MultiSelectProps<T extends ChoiceValue> = ChoiceControlProps & {
  readonly value: readonly T[];
  readonly onChange: (value: readonly T[]) => void;
  readonly options: readonly SelectOption<T>[];
  readonly placeholder?: string;
};
declare function MultiSelect<T extends ChoiceValue>({ value, onChange, options, placeholder, ...props }: MultiSelectProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element;
type SearchFieldProps = ChoiceControlProps & {
  readonly value: string;
  readonly onChange: (value: string) => void;
  readonly placeholder?: string;
};
declare function SearchField$1({ value, onChange, placeholder, ...props }: SearchFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type TargetResult = {
  readonly status: 'ready';
  readonly value: number;
} | {
  readonly status: 'pending';
  readonly lastValue?: number;
} | {
  readonly status: 'no-fit';
  readonly message?: string;
} | {
  readonly status: 'error';
  readonly message: string;
};
type NumberRangeValue = {
  readonly start: number;
  readonly end: number;
};
type DateRangeValue = {
  readonly start: string;
  readonly end: string;
};
type StatusTone = 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';
type StatusOption<T extends string | number> = {
  readonly value: T;
  readonly label: ReactNode;
  readonly textValue?: string;
  readonly tone: StatusTone;
  readonly icon?: ReactNode;
};
type ColorFormat = 'hex' | 'hexa' | 'rgb' | 'rgba' | 'hsl' | 'hsla' | 'hsb' | 'hsba';
type RangeSliderProps = DashStackControlProps & {
  /** Independent app-owned outcome; never changes the selected bounds. */
  readonly result?: TargetResult;
  readonly formatResult?: (value: number) => ReactNode;
  readonly startDetent?: SliderDetent;
  readonly endDetent?: SliderDetent;
  readonly formatValue?: (value: NumberRangeValue) => ReactNode;
  readonly createGesture?: ValueGestureFactory<NumberRangeValue>;
  readonly value: NumberRangeValue;
  readonly onChange: (value: NumberRangeValue) => void;
  readonly min?: number;
  readonly max?: number;
  readonly step?: number;
  readonly formatOptions?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions;
};
declare function RangeSlider(props: RangeSliderProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type MeterProps = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly min?: number;
  readonly max?: number;
  readonly formatOptions?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions;
  readonly formatValue?: (value: number) => ReactNode;
};
declare function Meter$1({ value, min, max, formatOptions, formatValue, ...props }: MeterProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type ProgressBarProps = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly value?: number;
  readonly min?: number;
  readonly max?: number;
  readonly formatOptions?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions;
  readonly formatValue?: (value: number) => ReactNode;
};
declare function ProgressBar$1({ value, min, max, formatOptions, formatValue, ...props }: ProgressBarProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type StatusProps<T extends string | number> = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly value: T;
  readonly options: readonly StatusOption<T>[];
};
declare function Status<T extends string | number>({ value, options, ...props }: StatusProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element;
type DateFieldProps = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly value: string | null;
  readonly onChange: (value: string | null) => void;
  readonly min?: string;
  readonly max?: string;
  readonly locale?: string;
  readonly granularity?: 'day';
  readonly hourCycle?: 12 | 24;
  readonly shouldForceLeadingZeros?: boolean;
};
declare function DateField({ value, onChange, min, max, locale, granularity, hourCycle, shouldForceLeadingZeros, ...props }: DateFieldProps): ReactNode;
type TimeFieldProps = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly value: string | null;
  readonly onChange: (value: string | null) => void;
  readonly min?: string;
  readonly max?: string;
  readonly locale?: string;
  readonly granularity?: 'hour' | 'minute' | 'second';
  readonly hourCycle?: 12 | 24;
  readonly shouldForceLeadingZeros?: boolean;
};
declare function TimeField$1({ value, onChange, min, max, locale, granularity, hourCycle, shouldForceLeadingZeros, ...props }: TimeFieldProps): ReactNode;
type DateTimeFieldProps = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly value: string | null;
  readonly onChange: (value: string | null) => void;
  readonly timeZone: string;
  readonly min?: string;
  readonly max?: string;
  readonly locale?: string;
  readonly granularity?: 'hour' | 'minute' | 'second';
  readonly hourCycle?: 12 | 24;
  readonly hideTimeZone?: boolean;
  readonly shouldForceLeadingZeros?: boolean;

declare function DateRangeField({ value, onChange, locale, shouldForceLeadingZeros, ...props }: DateRangeFieldProps): ReactNode;

  readonly value: string | null;

  readonly format?: ColorFormat;
};
declare function ColorField({ value, onChange, format, ...props }: ColorFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type TargetNumberResult = TargetResult;
type TargetNumberProps = NumberFieldProps & {
  readonly result: TargetNumberResult;
  readonly targetLabel?: string;
  readonly actualLabel?: string;
  readonly formatValue?: (value: number) => ReactNode;
};
/** Two fields with one editable target and one application-owned actual result. */
declare function TargetNumber({ result, targetLabel, actualLabel, formatValue, unit, ...props }: TargetNumberProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type TargetSliderResult = TargetResult;
type TargetSliderProps = Omit<SliderProps, 'fillOrigin' | 'startDetent' | 'endDetent' | 'onChange'> & {
  readonly result: TargetSliderResult;
  readonly onChange: (value: number | null) => void;
  readonly inputValue?: number | null;
  readonly unit?: string;
  readonly formatValue?: (value: number) => ReactNode;
};
declare function TargetSlider({ result, value, inputValue, unit, formatValue, onChange, min, max, step, marks, ...props }: TargetSliderProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type DashStackControlProps = {
  readonly id?: string;
  readonly 'aria-label'?: string;
  readonly 'aria-labelledby'?: string;
  readonly 'aria-describedby'?: string;
  readonly 'aria-invalid'?: boolean | 'true' | 'false';
  readonly 'aria-errormessage'?: string;
  readonly disabled?: boolean;
  readonly readOnly?: boolean;
  readonly className?: string;
};

};
declare function TextField$1({ value, onChange, multiline, minRows, placeholder, ...props }: TextFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type NumberFieldProps = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly onChange: (value: number | null) => void;
  readonly min?: number;
  readonly max?: number;
  readonly step?: number;
  readonly placeholder?: string;
  readonly unit?: string;
  readonly formatOptions?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions;
};
declare function NumberField$1({ value, onChange, min, max, step, placeholder, unit, formatOptions, ...props }: NumberFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type SliderMark = {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly label?: ReactNode;
};
type SliderProps = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly createGesture?: NumericGestureFactory;
} & SliderOptions & {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly onChange: (value: number) => void;
  readonly min?: number;
  readonly max?: number;
  readonly step?: number;
  readonly marks?: readonly SliderMark[];
  readonly formatOptions?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions;
  readonly formatValue?: (value: number) => ReactNode;
};
declare function Slider$1(props: SliderProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type SwitchProps = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly isSelected: boolean;
  readonly onChange: (isSelected: boolean) => void;
};
declare function Switch$1({ isSelected, onChange, ...props }: SwitchProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
type SelectOption<T extends string | number> = T | {
  readonly value: T;
  readonly label?: ReactNode;
  readonly textValue?: string;
  readonly icon?: ReactNode;
  readonly disabled?: boolean;
};
type SelectProps<T extends string | number> = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly value: T | undefined;
  readonly onChange: (value: T) => void;
  readonly options: readonly SelectOption<T>[];
  readonly placeholder?: string;
};
declare function Select$1<T extends string | number>({ value, onChange, options, placeholder, ...props }: SelectProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element;
type SegmentedControlProps<T extends string | number> = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly value: T | undefined;
  readonly onChange: (value: T) => void;
  readonly options: readonly SelectOption<T>[];
};
declare function SegmentedControl<T extends string | number>({ value, onChange, options, ...props }: SegmentedControlProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element;
type DisplayProps = DashStackControlProps & {
  readonly value: unknown;
  readonly renderedValue?: ReactNode;
  readonly isFormatted?: boolean;
};
declare function Display({ value, renderedValue, isFormatted, ...props }: DisplayProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
